author: barnabemonnot
content:
I'm not sure I'd generalise this way, there is probably a greater emphasis on throughput from the people working on ZK, and they'd not be eagerly advocating for slot time reductions, but afaict they are not rejecting outright any change to the slot time.

Again I think 10s threads a good needle, where it's very very unlikely that we'd regret in the future having moved to 10s in Hegotá. And then as we progress on zk and consensus I expect more reductions will seem at hand, that we'll feel comfortable shipping if we feel we'd not regret them either.

author: greystroke
content: I feel like this proposal would be helped if we had someone from the lean ethereum team, such as <@269786774660710400>, state they are comfortable with a 10-second slot time. I can't think of any other reason people would not support shorter slot times otherwise.
